notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental receipts/disbursements, transfers and fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total column (p5, report p15; added by the v8 re-trim, replacing figures previously derived from the Statement of Activities pp2-3). Loan proceeds 285,396 are printed inside Total revenues 1,002,646 but recorded in debt_proceeds, not receipts. Contributions and grants 54,107 split using the General Fund departments schedule (p10): contributions 40,882, grant income 13,225. Principal 315,396 and interest 9,956 are printed separately. Governmental beginning cash = fund balance 9/30/2024 712,872 (no liabilities); ending cash 894,495 ties to the governmental Balance Sheet (p4, report p14) and the Statement of Net Position (p1). Transfers: Street Fund in 188,724; General out 72,737 + Community Development Agency out 115,987 (p5; also all-funds budget schedule p9), net zero. Business-type from proprietary statements (pp6-8): sales 188,914 + other revenue 1,170 = total 190,084; expenses 108,014 operating + 45,000 principal + 22,494 interest = 175,508. Detail: General Fund departments schedule (p10) recorded for the General Fund (Salaries and benefits combined into salaries and wages; budget not shown); the all-funds budget schedule (p9) governmental lines omitted to avoid double counting the General Fund; its business-type lines recorded with budget. Read pages 1-10 of 10 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p7) added for the funds that had no schedule. The Water, Sewer and Trash lines from the all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (expenditures only; did not tie) are replaced by the proprietary statement's fund columns. Re-check 2026-10-28 (attempt 2): balance sheet governmental lines now from the Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p4: cash 885,995 + county treasurer 8,500 = 894,495; fund balance Restricted 5,027/803,508/13,633, Assigned budgetary stabilization 72,327), since its totals equal the Statement of Net Position governmental column (p1, 894,495); business-type lines stay from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Totals unchanged (assets 1,036,832 = equity 1,036,832). Report page references in notes corrected (p4 = report p14, p5 = report p15).
